caveats:
The www.gadm.org source used for the previous version of this COD-AB assigns administrative level 2 feature ‘Taboga’ to ‘Panamá Oeste’ province instead of ‘Panamá’ province.  This has been corrected in this COD-AB.

Users are guided to note that administrative level 1 feature Emberá [PA06] consists of two large non-continugous polygons (one of which is surrounded by Darién [PA05]), each containing only one administrative level 2 feature.

notes:
Panama administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 13 province or indigenous territory (provincia o comarca comarca indígena)  
- Admin 2: 76 district or indigenous territory (distrito o comarca indígena)  
- Admin 3: 594 municpiality (corregimiento)  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 20 October 2021: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 15 June 2020: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 15 June 2020: boundaries created by the source  
  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
